subject: Request: Reciprocity & Pricing Benchmark Waiver for Orpheus POC
messages:
From: Ethan Zhao <ethan.zhao@orpheus.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Hughes <sara.hughes@orpheus.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC pricing + MFN-style ask

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with a 3-month POC. Before we finalize the SOW, legal asked for two items we need your help with: (1) a pricing benchmark clause that ties our unit price to observed token-cost/perf metrics (if your model costs drop, our price should adjust), and (2) a Most-Favored-Nation (MFN)-style reciprocity clause so Orpheus is protected if you offer better pricing to a comparable buyer for similar usage.

We attached the proposed SOW and a redline that shows the two clauses. For the POC we are proposing a 30% upfront committed discount and the MFN would apply to any published list price for the next 12 months. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept these commercial terms or if we need to escalate?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@orpheus.ai) for billing cadence.

Cheers,
Ethan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Orpheus Analytics

Attachments: Orpheus_SOW_March2027.pdf, Orpheus_MFN_Redline.docx

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Zhao <ethan.zhao@orpheus.ai>
Cc: Sara Hughes <sara.hughes@orpheus.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC pricing + MFN-style ask

Ethan — thanks for the clarity and the SOW. Appreciate you sending the redline. I can confirm these are non-standard asks for a POC. I will escalate to internal Deal Desk and Legal for risk assessment. Quick summary of Orpheus ask for internal folks: 30% committed discount on POC, MFN that references published list price for 12 months, and a benchmark adjustment that would allow retroactive price moves based on measured token/cost metrics.

We will come back with one of: (A) executive-approved limited waiver with carve-outs and sunset, or (B) an alternative agreement that preserves economics without broad MFN exposure. Targeting to respond with a proposal by EOD Friday.

—Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC pricing + MFN-style ask — legal analysis

Priyom / Laura — reviewed Orpheus redline. Flagging key legal/commercial risks: 

- MFN scope is undefined: as written it would apply to any "published list price" which can capture internal promos, reseller deals, and channel discounts — extremely open-ended.
- Benchmark clause is operationally risky: it allows retroactive price adjustments tied to metrics we may not be able to independently verify; also could require us to return credits which impacts revenue recognition.
- Duration + audit: 12 months plus no audit language. Need to limit to POC period and add logs/audit rights and dispute resolution for metrics.

My recommended redlines (high level):
- Narrow MFN to a specific SKU/usage band, exclude reseller/channel/promotional pricing, cap remedy to a one-time credit up to X% of POC value (suggest 15% cap).
- Convert benchmark to a forward-looking adjustment (future invoices) rather than retroactive credits; tie it to metrics we control and that are recorded in our telemetry.
- Add sunset: MFN and benchmark apply only to the POC term (3 months) + 30 days to transition.
- Executive approval required for any discount >25% or any MFN carve-in.

Attached redline includes language examples (Orpheus_MFN_Redline.docx). If Sales wants to offer something closer to their ask, Legal can accept a limited waiver with the above guardrails.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orpheus_MFN_Redline.docx

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC pricing + MFN-style ask — Deal Desk perspective

Team — quick commercial view: Orpheus is a strategic early customer in analytics vertical; POC could lead to a multi-year deployment. Recommendation: approve a constrained exception to keep momentum, subject to these controls: 

1) Max one-time discount cap 30% for POC, but only if funded commit > $75k ARR equivalent; otherwise cap discount at 20%.
2) MFN limited to identical procurement channel and SKU (no channel/reseller parity). Include a carve-out for marketplace promotions and reseller programs.
3) Benchmark only affects forward pricing (no retroactive credits), and any future downward adjustments require RVP approval after metrics verification.
4) Limit duration to 3 months + 30 day transition. After that, standard list pricing applies.

If Leadership signs off I will instruct Finance to create a one-off pricing plan and mark the deal as "waiver-approved" in Deal Desk. Requesting Laura or another exec to sign the approval.

—Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC pricing + MFN-style ask — approval request

Laura — forwarding summary and recommendation for executive sign-off. Customer expecting answer early next week. Proposed commercial package to present to Orpheus: 

- Offer: 3-month POC, committed usage tier, 25% one-time POC discount (net of promos).
- MFN: limited MFN applying only to the exact SKU and procurement channel in this SOW; excludes resellers/marketplace/promos; remedy capped to a one-time credit of 15% of POC fees.
- Benchmark: forward-looking adjustment on future invoices only; metrics must be validated by Redwood telemetry; any downward price adjustment requires RVP approval.
- Duration: POC term + 30-day sunset.

Legal (Marissa) has redlined the agreement; Deal Desk (Rishi) supports conditional waiver with the caps above. Can you approve so I can send a counter and schedule the DocuSign? If you want to tweak the discount cap we can adjust before sending.

Thanks — Priyom

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Orpheus limited waiver (conditional)

Thanks team — I approve a limited, conditional waiver subject to the following mandatory edits and ops steps (must be in final SOW before sending to Orpheus):

- Discount: cap at 25% for the POC. Any discount >25% requires CRO sign-off.
- MFN: restrict to the exact SKU and procurement channel; exclude marketplace/resellers/promotions; remedy limited to a one-time credit not to exceed 15% of the POC invoice. Insert explicit audit and dispute resolution wording per Marissa's redline.
- Benchmark: convert to forward-only price adjustments; Redwood telemetry records are authoritative; any downward adjustment requires RVP approval and a 30-day notice. No retroactive billing credits.
- Term: POC 3 months + 30-day sunset.
- Finance: create one-off billing code and revenue deferral treatment; record deal in HubSpot with "waiver-approved" tag (Deal ID DEAL-2027-0531).

Priyom — once Laws/legal confirm the final redline, send the revised SOW to Orpheus with the above language and include a short cover email explaining the carve-outs. Rishi — please coordinate with Finance to ensure the billing plan is set.

Approved by: Laura Bennett
Director, West Coast Sales | Redwood Inference
